item.title: Casual Talking Camera Testimonial

exact_text: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical testimonial-style ad for FitTrack. A fictional woman in her 30s, filming herself at home, talks to camera: “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” Friendly and casual, with matching captions. Use a made-up presenter, not a real customer.

item.tests: Checks delivery of a short scripted talking-camera ad with audible speech and accurate captions, rather than a silent portrait or unrelated montage.

answer_sheet.Platform and size: Vertical 9:16 for a social reel; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Presenter: A fictional woman in her thirties, filming herself at home; not a real customer.
answer_sheet.Script and captions: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.
answer_sheet.Language, voice and mood: English, friendly and casual; specific accent is your call.

must_haves: One approximately 8-second vertical video shows a fictional adult woman addressing the camera in a home setting.
The complete supplied script is audible in English without omissions or added testimonial claims.
Readable captions reproduce the supplied script exactly and follow the speech.
The presenter visibly speaks rather than remaining a still image throughout.
The ad does not label the fictional presenter as a verified or real customer.

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical testimonial-style ad for FitTrack. A fictional woman in her 30s, filming herself at home, talks to camera: “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” Keep it friendly and casual, with matching captions. Use a made-up presenter, not a real customer. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent credits.** A fictional presenter is fine; I’d label the ad **“AI-generated presenter · dramatization”** so it isn’t presented as a real customer testimonial.

### Your requested 8-second ad
The planned workflow is:
1. Create a vertical image of a fictional woman in her 30s at home.
2. Animate it with your exact spoken script.
3. Add matching captions.

**There’s a free-plan limit:** the scripted-ad tool caps videos at **5 seconds unless you’ve purchased a credit pack**. The eligible free settings are **LTX 2.5 at 480p**.

### Cost before running
- **Presenter image:** 5 credits using Flux 2 Klein at 640px.
- **Speaking video and captions:** I can’t verify their exact credit charges with the tools available here.
- **Total:** not yet verifiable, so I won’t submit a generation or give you a guessed quote.

### Cheaper options
| Option | Trade-off |
|---|---|
| **5-second vertical video at 480p** | Shorter script; lower-duration option within the no-credit-pack limit |
| **Static vertical ad** | **5 credits** for one generated image with ad copy; no speech or motion |

For the shorter video, I suggest:
> “FitTrack makes workout planning easy. Finally, a routine that sticks.”

Your full 16-word script would also sound more natural over roughly 8 seconds than squeezed into five.

**One more constraint:** Magic Hour’s guidance says commercial use requires a paid subscription, a credit-pack purchase, or an agreed paid usage arrangement—even if generation uses free-plan settings.

Would you prefer the **5-credit static ad**, or to **hold off until the speaking-video and caption costs—and commercial-use eligibility—are confirmed**?

Do you mean the **static vertical ad for 5 credits**? That would feature the fictional presenter and your original quote as text, with **no video or audio**, plus an “AI-generated presenter · dramatization” label.

I’ll wait for confirmation so I don’t spend credits on the wrong option.

turns.agent:
The generation was refused because your account has **insufficient credits**. No ad was created, and this attempt spent no credits.

The static version needs **5 credits**. I haven’t retried or started anything else.

style.prompt: Create a polished but friendly, casual vertical static social media ad for FitTrack. Photorealistic entirely fictional woman in her 30s, not based on any real person or customer, in casual modest workout clothing, smiling naturally toward a phone camera in a warm lived-in home living room, yoga mat subtly visible in the background. Authentic selfie-style framing and soft daylight, not glossy corporate photography. Design with excellent text legibility, generous safe margins, clean modern typography, restrained teal accents and warm neutral colors. At top show brand text exactly 'FitTrack'. Include the full main quote exactly: “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” Lay out the quote attractively in readable lines without covering her face. At bottom include a clearly legible disclosure exactly: 'AI-generated presenter · dramatization'. Do not include a customer name, star ratings, verified-customer badges, fake app screenshots, or additional claims. This is a static ad with text, not a video.
